WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_sw, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND r.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) AS fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, m.mine, c.ctl, round(m.mine-c.ctl,2) AS gap
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE m.mine IS NULL OR c.ctl IS NULL OR abs(m.mine-c.ctl) > 1
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines,
       min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_loaded, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_loaded,
       count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS load_stamps
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
GROUP BY 1

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
sw AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS sales, count(DISTINCT d.calendar_date) AS days_with_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week <= 39
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT t.store_id, t.fiscal_week, t.sales AS ty, l.sales AS ly, t.days_with_sales AS ty_days, l.days_with_sales AS ly_days, round(t.sales/l.sales,3) AS ratio
FROM sw t LEFT JOIN sw l ON l.store_id=t.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year='FY2024/25'
WHERE t.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND (l.sales IS NULL OR t.sales/l.sales < 0.7 OR t.sales/l.sales > 1.4 OR t.days_with_sales < 6 OR l.days_with_sales < 6)
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'stores with >1 current row' AS chk, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'physical stores current', count(DISTINCT store_id) FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup return_line_id in Q3 range', count(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales lines returned more than once', count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns with no matching sales line', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup dim_date days', count(*) FROM (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales lines with null/unmatched store_key', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_key=f.store_key)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales lines unmatched product_key', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_product s WHERE s.product_key=f.product_key)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales lines in store 999 or ZZ test (Q3 both yrs)', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
